messages:
maria (partnerships): Quick sync — we're finalizing the cost model inputs for partner SKUs. Need: spot/reserved hourly, commit buckets, eviction correlation, marketplace listing fee, and any joint-marketing credits. Can you send CSV exports?
emily (si-integ): Hi team — we aggregate multiple vendors. Prefer one consolidated feed per vendor + a small manifest describing transforms. Is a JSON manifest okay or you want everything in CSV?
maria (partnerships): CSV is easiest for our cost sheet — flat rows. But a tiny manifest (one-line text) pointing to the CSV is fine.
kaito (corebeam): We'll provide CSV + a manifest.txt. Also note: some regions have a "grace pool" with lower eviction risk; we'll flag those SKUs.
emily (si-integ): Proposed CSV header (single line):
```
sku,provider,region,spot_usd_per_hr,reserved_usd_per_hr,commit_hours,commit_tier_label,eviction_multi_hour_corr,eviction_prob_hour,grace_pool_tag,avg_preempt_notice_mins,marketplace_fee_pct,reseller_fee_pct,partner_marketing_credit_usd_per_hr,one_time_announcement_credit_usd,capex_proxy_usd_per_hr,notes
```
maria (partnerships): Nice. Please use ISO region codes. For eviction_multi_hour_corr use a simple tag: NONE, SHORT (<=3h), LONG (>3h). We'll map to correlation multipliers in model.
kaito (corebeam): Sample rows:
```
CB-RTX6000,corebeam,us-west-2,1.05,0.72,720,3mo,SHORT,0.004,TRUE,45,0.08,0.03,0.15,5000,0.55,"grace pool during nights"
CB-RTX8000,corebeam,eu-central-1,1.50,0.95,8760,12mo,LONG,0.015,FALSE,10,0.10,0.05,0.20,0,0.85,"higher p95 eviction due to maintenance"
```
emily (si-integ): Also include column "announce_ready" TRUE/FALSE if partner ok with joint press/marketplace promo. We filter for campaignable SKUs.
ajay (finance): Good call. For modeling ramp we need planned_capacity_dates as an RFC list (comma-delimited): e.g., 2026-05-01->100,2026-06-01->300 to indicate additional units.
kaito (corebeam): We'll add planned_capacity_dates and a simple unit_count estimate per date.
olga (marketplace): Also include "listing_hold_days" to reflect lead time to get on marketplace (we'll charge a one-time onboarding fee if <14 days).
maria (partnerships): On the cost side, we apply a sticky discount when reserved conversion > 70% or commit_hours >= 8760. We'll need exit_penalty_pct as a column if there are early-exit terms.
emily (si-integ): We'll include "exit_penalty_pct" and "early_exit_schedule_url" (link) where relevant.
vendor-bot: Upload received: s3://redwood-internal/partner-feeds/corebeam/1724003718_v1.csv  validating... parsed 12 SKUs, warnings: 3 SKUs missing planned_capacity_dates.
ajay (finance): For spot volatility, if you can provide p50/p90 spot or a short sample timeseries url we can ingest to compute tails. Even a 7-day hourly sample helps.
kaito (corebeam): We'll attach p50/p90 and a small sample timeseries for each SKU in the manifest (s3 path).
maria (partnerships): Scheduling: we'll ingest v1 today and run baseline; ask partners to send final CSV by Wed EOD with p90/p99 if available.
olga (marketplace): Ops note: if marketplace_fee_pct > 0.12 in any region, we'll require a separate billing SLA — ping us before listing.
emily (si-integ): One more: include a boolean "allow_spot_preference" for customers who can tolerate preemptions — helps us model routing and blended price.
ajay (finance): When you upload, tag rows with internal_sku_id if you have one (helps de-duping across vendors).
kaito (corebeam): Adding internal_sku_id now. Uploading v2 with p50/p90, planned_capacity_dates, exit_penalty_pct, internal_sku_id, and timeseries_sample links.
vendor-bot: Upload received: s3://redwood-internal/partner-feeds/corebeam/1724003718_v2.csv  validating... parsed 29 SKUs, warnings: 1 SKU missing timeseries_sample, using region default.
maria (partnerships): Thanks team. We'll run the sensitivity sheet: commit tenor (1m/3m/12m), marketplace_fee impact, and listing lag. @olga @ajay please join Fri review 10:30.
ajay (finance): I'll prep a delta heatmap for unit economics per SKU and send a calendar invite.
olga (marketplace): I'll bring marketplace fee thresholds and a checklist for listing readiness.
emily (si-integ): Cool — post-ingest can we set up a webhook so future CSVs auto-notify us? We prefer automation.
maria (partnerships): Yep. We'll share the ingest webhook and schema validator. Thanks all.
